capabilities: Sync notes and attachments through a private GitHub branch
Preview and select incoming and outgoing file changes
Resolve conflicts by keeping local, remote, or both copies
Restore earlier note versions from GitHub commit history
extras: Uploads require a manual sync; automatic receive can be enabled. The GitHub token is stored in Obsidian's secret storage, and the plugin has no telemetry.
problem: Syncing a vault across devices through GitHub otherwise requires manual Git commands and offers no guided way to review files or resolve conflicting edits.

relations.evidence: enable the Git community plugin and turn on Use the Git plugin on this computer
Sync notes and attachments between desktop and mobile through a private GitHub repository.

requires.name: GitHub fine-grained token with Contents read and write

summary: Syncs notes and attachments between desktop and mobile through a private GitHub branch, with selective uploads and conflict resolution.
